brief:
The United States is pursuing the extradition of James "Fergie" Chambers, a Gaza aid supporter currently imprisoned in Spain, according to Al Jazeera English. Chambers faces accusations of providing material support to Hamas, though he has maintained that his financial contributions went to registered charities operating in the territory.

Chambers's wife has warned that his extradition would set a "terrifying precedent" for criminalizing humanitarian assistance to Gaza. The case raises questions about the legal boundaries between legitimate charity work and material support designations that the U.S. applies to Palestinian organizations.
dek: Imprisoned in Spain, James 'Fergie' Chambers has supported charities but is accused of aiding Hamas.
title: US seeks extradition of Gaza donor imprisoned in Spain
